dedupe_keys.name: topografija lv map viewer with high detail topographic information and utility coordination data latvia

description: Topografija.lv is an information map viewer for surveyors, municipal staff and others in Latvia. Its free datasets include OpenStreetMap, orthophoto maps from several national aerial survey cycles (1994 to 1999 at 1 metre, 2010 to 2011 at 0.5 metre and 2013 to 2015 at 0.4 metre), Soviet-era topographic maps at scales from 1:10,000 to 1:1,000,000, national and local geodetic network data, the locations of validated permanent GNSS base stations, and the database of high-detail topographic information (ADTI) maintainers and utility coordinators. Paid datasets are the high-detail topographic information itself, current national address register data and the current cadastral map, with subscriptions of 50 euros for one month to 240 euros for twelve months. Each municipality is listed as an ADTI maintainer with its contacts, regulations, price list and the ADTI databases it maintains; for example Daugavpils city lists its database of 1 July 2021 covering all parishes. The site also has a geodetic points section and an API. Caveats: the detailed topographic and utility data is paid and needs a user account, and the pages are in Latvian. Coverage is Latvia. It supports multi-sector asset mapping of underground utilities and surveyed features in towns, and capacity planning; the related record is the CityGML Utility Network ADE, a model for exchanging such utility data.
